rationale.intuition: Recruited athlete is dominant hook at Stanford — Arcidiacono SFFA data shows recruited athletes at Harvard admitted at ~88%; Stanford expected similar magnitude. URM contextual signal stacks on top (post-SFFA, narrative-coded). REA round adds modest yield-protection lift. Below-25th-percentile academics (3.7/1380 vs Stanford 3.95/1530) acceptable because athletic slot system bypasses regular review. Counselor consensus 50-90% for verified athlete + URM-coded REA combo.

sources.evidence: D1 recruited athletes at T20 see 30-50× lift in admit rate; URM signal adds modest contextual lift in post-SFFA holistic review.

sources.name: Crimson Multi-Hook Stack Report 2024
sources.evidence: Recruited athlete + URM contextual signal at T5 schools admit 60-90% per published case data — athlete remains dominant, URM is rounding factor.
